services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive event solutions, tailored to your vision
services.description: Everything you need to create unforgettable events and experiences
services.pageSubtitle: From first sketch to final teardown, our specialized teams handle every layer of your event.

boothExperts.title: BOOTH EXPERTS, DESIGN & BUILD
boothExperts.description: Professional booth design and construction services that bring your brand vision to life with expert craftsmanship.
boothExperts.longDescription: Our design and build team works from concept sketches through structural engineering to on-site construction, delivering custom exhibition booths that stand out on any show floor. We manage materials, fabrication, logistics, and installation end-to-end, so every panel, light, and finish reflects your brand with precision.

conferences.title: CONFERENCES & EXHIBITIONS
conferences.description: Comprehensive conference and exhibition management services that deliver impactful and memorable experiences.
conferences.longDescription: We plan and operate conferences and exhibitions of every scale — venue selection, floor planning, speaker logistics, registration, and on-site management — coordinating every vendor and moving part so the event runs seamlessly from doors-open to close.

photography.title: PHOTOGRAPHY
photography.description: Capture every moment with our professional photography services, ensuring your events are documented beautifully.
photography.longDescription: Our photography team documents your event from setup to teardown, delivering polished coverage of key moments, guest interactions, and booth details — ready for marketing, recaps, and future proposals.

catering.title: CATERING SERVICES
catering.description: Premium catering solutions that delight your guests with exceptional cuisine and impeccable service.
catering.longDescription: From formal plated dinners to interactive food stations, our catering partners design menus around your event's tone and audience, handling service staff, equipment, and logistics so hospitality never becomes a distraction.

digitalEntertainment.title: DIGITAL ENTERTAINMENT
digitalEntertainment.description: Cutting-edge digital entertainment experiences that engage and captivate your audience.
digitalEntertainment.longDescription: We integrate interactive screens, projection mapping, live visuals, and digital activations into your event, giving attendees memorable moments to engage with and share.

serviceSquad.title: SERVICE SQUAD
serviceSquad.description: Dedicated professional teams providing comprehensive event support and management excellence.
serviceSquad.longDescription: A dedicated on-ground crew — ushers, hosts, technicians, and coordinators — trained to represent your brand and keep every operational detail running smoothly throughout the event.

about.heading: About Us
about.heroSubtitle: Where visions are transformed into real experiences since 2008
about.storyLead: Established in 2008, Kasr Al-Amouyyeen (KAM) has grown into a leading company specializing in booth construction and full-scale event management.
about.paragraph1: We deliver end-to-end solutions that transform ideas into immersive experiences—covering everything from concept development and planning to flawless execution. Whether it's exhibitions, conferences, or private events, we create environments that elevate brand presence and leave lasting impressions.
about.paragraph2: Our team brings extensive expertise in designing and executing distinctive events that align with our clients' vision and objectives. We proudly serve public and private sectors, as well as individual clients.
about.paragraph3: Driven by innovation and a commitment to excellence, we continuously push boundaries to deliver creative, high-quality results—earning the trust of our partners project after project.
